scope: Source-backed continuation; unconfirmed questions are not represented as verified.

corrected_questions.reason: The first electric passenger train ran between Bombay VT and Kurla on 3 February 1925. Deccan Queen was a later train; remove that conflation.

a: Bombay Victoria Terminus (now Mumbai CSMT) and Kurla
बॉम्बे विक्टोरिया टर्मिनस (अब मुंबई CSMT) और कुर्ला

stems.en: Between which stations did India's first electric passenger train run on 3 February 1925?
stems.hi: 3 फरवरी 1925 को भारत की पहली विद्युत यात्री ट्रेन किन स्टेशनों के बीच चली थी?

corrected_questions.reason: Correct the misspelled currency name Bhat to Baht.
The final Census 2011 sex ratio is 943. The old 940 figure was provisional; specify final results.

stems.en: What is India's sex ratio according to the final results of Census 2011?
stems.hi: 2011 की जनगणना के अंतिम परिणामों के अनुसार भारत का लिंगानुपात क्या है?

corrected_questions.reason: Correct Demographic Divide to Demographic Dividend; the keyed working-age population answer is unchanged.
Update the present-tense organisation from CSO to NSO, which releases current national-income estimates.

c: राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी कार्यालय (NSO), सांख्यिकी एवं कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय

stems.en: Which organisation currently prepares and releases the official national-income estimates of India?
stems.hi: भारत के आधिकारिक राष्ट्रीय आय अनुमान वर्तमान में कौन-सा संगठन तैयार और जारी करता है?

corrected_questions.reason: The reverse repo rate is an interest rate, not an outright sale of government securities. Restore its RBI liquidity-absorption definition.

b: The interest rate at which the RBI absorbs liquidity from banks against eligible government securities
वह ब्याज दर जिस पर RBI पात्र सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों के बदले बैंकों से तरलता अवशोषित करता है

corrected_questions.reason: Restore the repo lending-rate definition rather than describing it only as securities buying.

b: The rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to banks against eligible securities

corrected_questions.reason: Restore lost degree symbols and clarify that the International Date Line approximately follows 180 degrees.

d: यह लगभग 180° देशांतर का अनुसरण करती है
